packageRules.description: scripts/repair-renovate-lockfiles.sh refreshes pnpm lockfiles before Renovate commits.
Batch stable minor and patch updates into one pull request, same as group:allNonMajor, and automerge it after CI passes. GitHub Actions are not included.
This token cannot push workflow file changes, so GitHub Actions updates are not attempted.
CI installs the pnpm version pinned in the workflow. This token cannot update that pin, so a packageManager bump fails every job.
Do not treat potentially breaking 0.x minor releases as routine updates
Require explicit dashboard approval for major updates
ts-proto updates require regenerated Worker runtime clients
Keep ts-proto minor and patch updates in their own pull request
